typography.needle_typography: STIX mathematical italic N with upright typeset subscript digits
typography.font_embedding: data-URI fontSource on mathematical cells, plus model extFonts; SVG export includes the font

layout.panel_separation: two single horizontal rules; no outer frames
layout.AB_font_rule: 20.5-unit minimum for small labels; 23-24 units for mechanism text
layout.AB_spacing: compact cards; taller multiline boxes and wider B answer-state box; connectors retargeted; bar heights and heatmap geometry unchanged
layout.C_header: one row for both mode names and NCC accuracies

terminology.consolidation_definition: functional formation of an executable final answer-query count state; applies to the terminal stage of CoT-Reasoning
terminology.consolidation_scope: supported by ordered partial trace-to-answer mediation and answer-state execution; does not establish identical operations or a shared unique circuit across modes
terminology.readout_layout: integrated into the thinking-trace row; no separate row label

palette.name: Warm-neutral mechanisms with vivid Aurora data colors
palette.tints: mechanisms: warm gray and parchment; attention charts: sequential Oranges

shared_attention.mapping: normalized share 0..1 maps linearly to Oranges palette positions 0..0.625; fixed bar color #F16913

palette.A_attention: fixed vivid orange bar fill; magnitude encoded by height only
palette.B_attention: light-to-vivid orange heatmap; magnitude encoded by within-record share
palette.count_gradient_source: restored continuous Aurora-derived count gradient; same colors in both modes
palette.count_color_adjustment: source count colors with 8% black; centroid fills darkened further only for white-label contrast

attention.aggregation: sum over each full registered prompt-record span
attention.normalization: each query row divided by its sum across the ten record spans
attention.display: shared sequential Oranges palette; A: fixed-color bars on explicit 0-20% axis; B: light-to-vivid orange palette on a linear 0-100% share scale

B.main_display_row_selection: user-requested item-end queries after items 2, 3, 4; earlier and later queries retained on page 2
B.orientation: rows are trace queries; columns are prompt records (transpose of v2 D)

mechanism.arrow_semantics: attention ONLY: source query to attended record keys; widths schematic
mechanism.other_mechanism_notation: A: unnumbered retrieval/consolidation/output group shifted left by 56 units; an ellipsis after N10 denotes remaining prompt context. B: two mechanism rows; Prompt span on the left, centered on the needle row; trace queries continue horizontally through an ellipsis for later steps into answer consolidation and output; all continuation links are unheaded
mechanism.scope: connected functional chain; complete unique mediation is unproven
mechanism.progress_state: distributed, content-bound event/progress state; no isolated scalar register claimed

representation.changes: same 3D projection and PCA data with retained 1.25x display zoom; point centers, axes and paths unchanged; scatter diameters increased by 20%; 24.5-unit centroid circles and 20.5-unit centered white digits; all data points retained

centroid_labels.alignment: center/middle; label bounds centered on paired centroid; native SVG text with Times New Roman Bold ink-bounds offsets

representation.pca_basis: separate discovery-fitted basis per mode; common camera only
representation.cohort: confirmation only: 10 seeds × 10 count states per mode

layer_selection.rule: each mode independently maximizes discovery-set grouped-OOF nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; ties are resolved by higher discovery logistic balanced accuracy and then the earlier layer

ncc.definition: held-out confirmation nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; computed independently of the display camera

camera.camera_source: shared adjusted manifold view: yaw=-0.72 rad, pitch=-0.45 rad

style_reference.scope: visual adaptation for mechanism nodes only; charts retain vivid orange and Aurora-derived count colors; no adoption of source arrow semantics or mechanism claims

print_readability.layout: vertical A-B-C, 1280x988; original point centers and camera retained

C.plot_transform: x about each plot center 320/960; y mapped from old plot top 544 to new plot top C_Y+46

A.colorbar_top_label: greater than or equal to clip threshold

B.display_orientation: three separated rows=Markers 2,3,4; ten equal-width needle-span cells per row
B.normalization: each displayed row sums to 1 over the ten complete needle spans
B.display: linear within-needle attention share; independent 0%-100% scale
B.target_annotation: blue outlined next-needle cell with 23-unit bold percentage below
B.raw_token_data_role: retained for validation and provenance; not used as displayed bins

spacing_revision.B_row_labels: Marker 2, Marker 3, Marker 4; vertical ellipses above and below

schematic_note: Numbered City items 2/3/4 abstract full item content. Blue outlined <marker 2/3/4> placeholders locate captured item-end attention readouts, attending to needles 3/4/5; labels are annotations, not generated tokens or needle markers. Marker 0 denotes initialization. No fixed newline or bullet token is asserted. <Ans> denotes the final answer query, not a literal special token.
